dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the apex to the posterior base, indicating high falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a small pixel radius, forming a sharp point at the maximum vertical extent.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply ascending linear-to-slightly-convex contour at approximately 45 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1.2 ratio between the visible base chord length and the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, mid-radius convex curve extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a high thickness-to-length ratio, extending anteriorly from the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle at the specific pixel junction where the melon slope transitions into the upper rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, bright white circular depigmentation mark (potential scar or lesion) located at the anterior base of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced teal/cyan light scattering across the entirety of the visible epidermis; visible peduncle narrowing prior to the tail fluke.
